title: Searching a trillion items
caption: An unstructured search of N = 10¹² items takes about N/2 = 5 × 10¹¹ classical queries on average, but only about (π/4)√N ≈ 7.9 × 10⁵ with Grover's algorithm: a quadratic speed-up, not an exponential one.
alt: Bar chart of the base-10 logarithm of the number of queries: 11.7 classical (5 times 10 to the 11) against 5.9 for Grover (7.9 times 10 to the 5).
description: The ratio is about 6 × 10⁵: huge, but √N, not exponential.
